description: This Java class 'ShareProductToGLAccountMappingHelper' provides abstractions for managing General Ledger (GL) account mappings related to share products in the Fineract accounting system. It includes methods for saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, as well as handling payment channels and charges specific to share products.

classes.name: ShareProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing GL account mappings for share products, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, as well as handling payment channels and charges.

methods.name: saveSharesToAssetAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of share product to an asset GL account.

methods.name: saveSharesToIncomeAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of share product to an income GL account.

methods.name: saveSharesToEquityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of share product to an equity GL account.

methods.name: saveSharesToLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of share product to a liability GL account.

methods.name: mergeSharesToAssetAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the asset account mapping for a share product.

methods.name: mergeSharesToIncomeAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the income account mapping for a share product.

methods.name: mergeSharesToEquityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the equity account mapping for a share product.

methods.name: mergeSharesToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the liability account mapping for a share product.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Saves payment channel to fund source mappings for share products.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates payment channel to fund source mappings for share products.

methods.name: saveChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves charge mappings to income accounts for share products.

methods.name: updateChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates charge mappings to income accounts for share products.

methods.name: populateChangesForNewSharesProductToGLAccountMappingCreation
methods.description: Prepares a map of changes for creating new share product to GL account mappings based on accounting rules.

methods.name: handleChangesToSharesProductToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Handles and applies changes to GL account mappings for a share product based on accounting rules.

methods.name: deleteSharesProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes GL account mappings for a specific share product.
